_provenance.animationPinning: infinite CSS animations pinned at currentTime 0 (paused) — the captured value is each animation's own 0% keyframe, a deterministic point of the declared animation; finite animations/transitions untouched. Pinned: r15mim6k, r18vhmn8, rb7n1on, rkgrvoi

interactionDrivers.portalCapture: baseline-diff portal reader (capture.portalSweep): the component's DOM contribution captured wherever React put it (portaled overlays included), one combo mounted at a time, DEFAULT interaction ONLY — overlay hover/focus/active states are a NAMED residual of the molecule round. Open-driver props: {"open":true}

_provenance.enumerationPolicy: full-cartesian (3 combos; cartesian 3 vs limit 512); enumeration-policy: full cartesian (3 ≤ 512)
